2.0.0: (breaking change) MakeApiCall: headers and parameters changed to key-value array inputs per standard #1459 — existing flows that previously set these as JSON strings must migrate to the key-value editor. Body remains textarea/JSON.
2.0.1: Output examples for every field of the Create/Get/Update Appointment, Contact, Deal and Task components.
2.0.2: MakeApiCall: Request Headers and Query Parameters set in the Designer are now sent. They were silently dropped: the key-value field stores its rows as a JSON object string, which the component did not parse.
2.0.3: Authentication: the bundle alias is validated before it is used to build request URLs. Only a Freshworks address is accepted (e.g. "acme-123.myfreshworks.com/crm/sales", or a legacy "acme.freshsales.io").
